title: They form when massive stars explode as supernovae.
purpose: Explain the basic formation process of neutron stars.
narration: Neutron stars form when massive stars explode as supernovae. During the explosion, the core collapses into an incredibly dense ball of neutrons. This creates an object just a few kilometers wide but with more mass than our Sun.
